plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Agribusiness, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 1104R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/agriculture-department/agribusiness/agribusiness-associate-of-arts/ . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four semester tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals 14/15/16/15). TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title). AWARD CORRECTION: the CSI 2024-2025 majors index lists Agribusiness as '30 60'; the official 2024-2025 Agribusiness major page offers ONLY 'Agribusiness, Intermediate Technical Certificate' and 'Agribusiness, Associate of Arts' - there is NO Agribusiness AAS in 2024-2025 (the AAS existed in older catalogs, e.g. 2017-2018, but was replaced by the AA). The 60 credits are the AA, the 30 the ITC. Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables sum 14+15+16+15 = 60. Choice slots: HUMA GE1 / HUMA GE2 / SOCS GE2 / SCIG GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice). PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (3 credits each semester, 12 total; student choice) - the page requires a minimum of 6 hours from the 'Agriculture Program Electives' list AND a minimum of 6 hours from the 'Business, Economics, and Accounting Electives' list printed on the page. Footnotes: Social & Behavioral Way of Knowing courses must be from 2 different disciplines (prefixes); Humanistic & Artistic Way of Knowing courses must be from 2 different disciplines (prefixes). The page notes the degree can be completed fully through online instruction (contact advisor). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
